title: From The Roof To The Water — EN/IT/PT (Pete McIvor)
style: country blues acoustic guitar warm baritone male vocal storytelling 100bpm walking bass brushed drums English Italian Portuguese language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
He built his first roof at twenty-two
Didn't think much about the ocean view
Just timber, tiles and sky above
That's a young man's work, that's a young man's love

[Verse 2 — Italiano]
Vent'anni di tetti, caldo d'estate a Perth [Twenty years of rooftops, Perth summer heat]
Un giorno disse che avrebbe trovato il mare, senza sapere perché [He said one day he'd find himself the sea, without knowing why]
Non riusciva a spiegare perché l'acqua lo chiamasse [Couldn't tell you why the water called]
Forse perché da ogni tetto, si vede tutto [Maybe because from every roof, you see it all]

[Chorus — English]
From the roof to the water, that's the road he took
Traded in the hammer for the anchor and the hook
Same man, same hands, same eyes looking far
From the roof to the water — that's who you are

[Bridge — Português]
Do telhado à água, esse foi o caminho que ele seguiu [From the roof to the water, that's the road he took]
Trocou o martelo pela âncora e o gancho [He traded the hammer for the anchor and the hook]
O mesmo homem, as mesmas mãos, os mesmos olhos ao longe [Same man, same hands, same eyes looking far]
Do telhado à água — é quem você é, é o seu destino [From the roof to the water — that's who you are, that's your destiny]

[Verse 3 — English]
Pelican Charters, sunrise on the bay
Oldest son became the captain of the day

[Outro — EN/IT/PT]
From the roof to the water
Dal tetto all'acqua [From the roof to the water]
Do telhado à água [From the roof to the water]
That's my boy
